notes.title: Neurodeck 1.3 available in beta branch!
notes.content:
[h3]Neurodeck 1.3 is available in the beta branch for now! It'll release in the Neurodeck app in two weeks.[/h3]

[h3]Things you can try[/h3]

[list]
[*] New stories (end of a fight or end of a session)
[*] Unlocks (you can reset your save but it will delete it)
[*] New phobias (Coulrophobia Cynophobia, Gnomophobia)
[*] Cloud save
[*] Inspecting pile of cards
[*] Random survey generation should be better
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36907763/d05171925a9e8a7f9bc42f976261ba499bf96c2c.png[/img]

[h3]How to access Neurodeck Beta?[/h3]

[olist]
[*] Go to your Library, right-click on the Neurodeck app, then select "Properties"
[*] Go to the "Betas" tab, then under "Select the Beta you want to opt into," select "beta - beta tests at your own risk"
[*] Finally, the Beta version will be uploaded automatically.
[/olist]

notes.title: Neurodeck 1.3 preview
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We are happy to see that many of you enjoyed Neurodeck 1.2 and its features!

Update 1.3 is up ahead and after the changes brought by 1.2, let’s take a look at what 1.3 has to offer:


[h3]3 new phobias[/h3]

This means new faces, new attacks and new animations & sound effects!

There will be one Rank 1 phobia and 2 Rank 2 phobias – [b]a slight trigger warning for those who fear clowns[/b].

[b]Those new phobias are unlockable[/b], we'll explain this right after introducing those new terrifying faces that will bring up your greatest fears!

Let's welcome:

[h3]Cynophobia[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36907763/3b7d0fd0af6a2cf7661434542298195712167ffc.gif[/img]

[h3]Gnomophobia[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36907763/bcf761b54837ea9a91664ee38b4126174a011a71.gif[/img]

[h3]Coulrophobia[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36907763/5df81bbcd041dc831aa7f0130acb927639f445d7.gif[/img]

[h3]Unlock system[/h3]

As you go through the game and beat mini-bosses and final bosses, [b]you’ll gradually unlock trials, Balcony cards and the 3 new phobias just revealed above[/b].

[b]This applies to new players only[/b], so if you've been playing Neurodeck for a while now, you will certainly have unlocked most of this stuff!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36907763/f0b1201237cc424171ff5fcf3e35f2c5c3986680.png[/img]

[h3]New stories about Lei and Jupiter[/h3]

During your session, you're free to read these new stories that will tell more about their own phobias as well as why they’re using the Neurodeck.

Those stories will appear:
[list]
[*] Once you've beaten a phobia
[*] At the end of your session
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36907763/bf7bf54ac5b51ab4a4f5257d3d6f2f7b4c7854c8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36907763/8ab420da15f9037e3ce0f26598c1a0d81a6ae762.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36907763/fa8803955a72775f3c96bd95d4d5c6e11c77a56c.png[/img]

[h3]Bug Fixes and some little adjustments[/h3]

Such as text formatting for character’s memories when entering Gymnasium, living room...

Hotkeys for keyboard play will also be added!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36907763/8c5c4ae0a39404d79c1c4324c88057912d55093d.gif[/img]

[h3]What’s next?[/h3]

After this update, there will be one and the last update that will focus on UX and UI, little adjustments and bug fix mainly. Then, Neurodeck will be stable enough to launch on Nintendo Switch! Thank you for your patience and your support towards the game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1253860/Neurodeck__Psychological_Deckbuilder/

notes.title: Neurodeck 1.2 is now live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Thank you for following the updates of Neurodeck! Gostique and Nemrod joined us last month to help with Neurodeck updates and did great work for this new patch. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1253860/announcements/detail/3041590589760012910]Victoria[/url] has also created new great art with a dozen new illustrations.

We added around 15 cards, a new preview system, new unique effects and globally new content that add a lot of replayability to the game. Next month will bring new phobias and we hope you’ll enjoy these new features as much as we do!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36907763/e682517ae3864788a0efd5f3d82c1d9e5ec9b7f2.png[/img]
[i]Hospital Visit, Hiking & Drawing cards illustrations from the Balcony room made by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1253860/announcements/detail/3041590589760012910]Victoria Guareschi[/url].[/i]

[h3]Here are the features of this update:[/h3]

[h3]Balancing[/h3]

Some cards have been boosted, some phobias have been nerfed and boosted!

[h3]Damage preview system[/h3]

This new preview system gives you a better overview of the situation in-game as well as an additional piece of information. We hope it’ll help you to better understand the different game systems and that you’ll manage to make decisions in better conditions!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36907763/ad3df63fa54b40d5ac5565bcb51e421ada42b4e0.png[/img]

[h3]14 more cards that belong to the "Balcony" room[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36907763/af3c5cbb61f8c43dcc32df42d54bf721a8b2a699.png[/img]

Here are the cards that you can find inside:
[list]
[*] Acting
[*] Beach Nap
[*] Broken Mirror
[*] Couple Counseling
[*] Drawing
[*] EMDR
[*] Hiking
[*] Hospital Visit
[*] Masking
[*] Wheel of emotions
[*] Rorschach Test
[*] Snowy Day
[*] Therapist
[*] Workout
[/list]
[b]Those cards are inspired by psychology to strengthen the link to mental health[/b] (EMDR which is a sensory stimulation therapy, Plutchik's wheel of emotions describing the 8 basic emotions, the broken mirror referring to the syndrome related to psychological and emotional trauma, etc.).

It adds another room so gives more replayability and more possibilities to your strategy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36907763/464bbc01d88d35dc223a4be11d3d52e6bfcb91e0.png[/img]
[i]Couple Counseling, Rorschach Test & Masking cards illustrations[/i]


[h3]New card effect "Discover"[/h3]

Inspired by [i]Hearthstone[/i], this effect allows you to discover a random card or can be a last-minute escape from a situation. [b]These apply to Balcony cards only[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36907763/44541e6663c5fb88e14b5ecc8a5eb7bcf2228897.png[/img]

[h3]New modifier "Weakness"[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36907763/e9b2e62d0e84148734784f0ef32734da54c128ec.png[/img]

Phobia or player will deal less damage and you have a preview of these damage on the cards. [b]This modifier is available in Balcony cards too[/b].


[h3]Player can gain Block[/h3]

Gaining Block will help you to build more defense and adds a little extra to your strategy. [b]You will find this feature in Balcony cards only[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36907763/d381fc90535967e2fed1ae0614c4d87ea1225e49.png[/img]

[h3]New traits[/h3]

[b]Those traits are available in the Nursery room[/b]. At the beginning of the game, you'll have to choose one of three traits proposed that will follow you for the rest of your session. Here are the traits you will encounter:
[list]
[*] Lucky
[*] Tenacious
[*] Laid back
[*] Funny
[*] Messy
[*] Shy
[*] Honest
[*] Dare-devil
[*] Improviser
[*] Frugal
[*] Contemplative
[*] Calming
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36907763/f9a7b6fe7c507c3686d85a6b11ce3e6ac349216c.png[/img]

[h3]Two additional resilience level[/h3]

In addition to the previous 1 to 5 resilience levels, levels 6 & 7 have been added.

[list]
[*] [b]Level 6[/b]: Nightmares: every phobia met is in nightmare mode.
[*] [b]Level 7[/b]: Mental Exhaustion: when you draw a card you lose 1 Sanity.
[/list]

[h3]New achievements[/h3]

Do you want to get more challenges in Neurodeck? With those new achievements, you’ll be able to make modifiers a strong weapon and to use resilience levels!

[list]
[*] [b]Resilient level X[/b]: Achieve a run with a resilient level. (1 à 7)
[*] [b]Passive-aggressive[/b]: Kill a phobia with a trait
[*] [b]Fast Forward[/b]: End a run with less than 10 cards in the deck.
[*] [b]Kill anxiety[/b]: Kill a phobia with the anxiety modifier
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36907763/ed03b146076d4450d0c5f5c64ce8e7e53d52eb41.gif[/img]

[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]

Some bugs may have been added while others may have been fixed! It’s hard to track everything and provide a complete bug list...

[h3]Official game guide[/h3]

Check out this complete guide explaining a lot of game mechanics. Useful when blocked on a phobia or wondering about a specific mechanic. Feel free to ask for more details! A big thank you to Chloé for creating this complete guide.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2462195327

[h3]Modding in the beta branch for now[/h3]

Modding is WIP so locked in beta branch; still checking how it should be working for the best use. Thanks for waiting!

[b]Here is how to access Neurodeck beta:[/b]
[list]
[*] Right-click on Neurodeck app, then click on "Properties"
[*] Go to the "Betas" tab, then under "Select the Beta you want to opt into," select "beta - beta tests at your own risk"
[*] Finally, the Beta version will be uploaded automatically.
[/list]

[h3]Switch release reminder[/h3]

We're still planning to finish the updates in order to have a patched and finalized version for Nintendo Switch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36907763/b4b6254455d3fea5fd30e18ee03db108d2ecb074.png[/img]

[h3]While waiting for Neurodeck 1.3, here's a little overview of Gnomophobia, which will be part of the new phobias![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36907763/ea6708680f124d4de42afcb17cf6d202aa88cd67.gif[/img]
[i]Animation made by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1253860/announcements/detail/3044967655749991488]Jeanne Prigent[/url].[/i]


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1253860?snr=2_groupannouncements_detail_

notes.title: Neurodeck side plans - Modding
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Modding has always sounded fun and challenging.

Things are quite WIP for now but there's still room for modding that can be added to Neurodeck.

[b]Of course, we're putting all our focuses on updates right now[/b], so this is not an urgent project, but the earlier we think about it, the faster we can put things in place.

[b]It's also worth mentioning that it doesn't take time on Neurodeck content-coding and its updates.[/b]

[h3][b]Here is an example of what it looks like at the moment:[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36907763/298323c7f3177d557896ed68f2ee8ba75860a478.png[/img]

[h3]What do you all think about it? Which modding features would you like to see in Neurodeck? And also, what would YOU like to mod in the game?[/h3]

[h3][b]Don't hesitate to share your thoughts & suggestions in the comment section![/b][/h3]

notes.title: Update 1.1 is now available
notes.content:
[h3][b]Before starting, a few important notes:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Some translations are still missing, but we wanted to update the game first and we can still patch the 1.1 version on Steam with new translations.
[*] Gostique & Nemrod, our two new coders on the updates, will be working on the 1.2 version that’ll be pushed in beta once in a while – find how to activate Neurodeck Beta [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1253860/announcements/detail/3012319095299490583]at the end of this post[/url]. It should be released next month.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36907763/d0b664893e12348417515a927d8a381ddd3e5daa.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36907763/27b7af6383722fae46b8bc9863ae861f6e244d77.png[/img]
[h3][b]Here’s what's in 1.1 patch note:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] The exploration scene has been revamped a bit, it’s now displaying some stuff better as well as the pacing changes we made;
[*] Pacing changes make basically a shorter game, but with a mini-boss in the middle and a boss at the end. Future updates will add more unlockable stuff;
[*] The fight phases have seen some stuff changed and revamped, such as Theophobia rules and stamina & sanity feedback display;
[*] Rooms Meditation: unlocks permanent stats for the run;
[*] “Survey” should propose a little less of the surveys you already answered, some work is still needed on this;
[*] You’ll see “Nightmare phobias,” which has improved attacks and health points. The display is a bit poor at the moment but we want to make it clearer.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36907763/e6b29c5ff7f20bd58cf53a1746fa73245862e6b0.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36907763/76b7ffc3ec2469fd5ae6f5db6cbbca22570cbcb0.png[/img]

[h3][b]Here is what’s planned for 1.2:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] New cards
[*] New rooms
[*] New resilience levels
[*] New nursery traits
[*] New achievements
[*] Improving the game feel
[*] Reworking the unlock system
[/list]
Please keep in mind [b]we might encounter challenges so some of those changes might get delayed[/b].

Please let us know if you encounter any bugs or things to improve! We’re aware that you're all committed for at least 3 months of work but [b]you’ll see patches every month[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36907763/d05171925a9e8a7f9bc42f976261ba499bf96c2c.png[/img]

[h3][b]Switch release[/b][/h3]

Switch release has been delayed and will be available at the end of the series of patches on Steam.

notes.title: Neurodeck upcoming updates & improvement goals
notes.content:
Dear Neurodeck players,

Thank you for participating in the launch of Neurodeck. The game had a good start until we realized the quality was not high enough and disappointed some of you! [b]We take this as a hint to keep working on it[/b]. Goblinz Studio & we have it in our DNA to not give up and provide updates to the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36907763/b59d2b81981e03370234a0160be09ffa612c5953.png[/img]

That said, development is expensive and it’s hard to say when some issues are just non-solvable because they’re in the DNA of the game.

So, we have decided to make updates to the game for the next 3 months. We’re going to hire new people on the development side and reattribute tasks to people who can work on those updates. These are unplanned expenses for us [b]but we know it’s necessary for the game[/b]. We will try to improve some aspects such as pacing, content and game feel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36907763/e8cb7ef9ca69e9d53253dbd45b27659d2097f12c.png[/img]

[h3]At the end of those 3 months, we’ll see what to do. [b]Please keep in mind these are objectives, not promises[/b].[/h3]

[h3]First priority: (hopes for the first month)[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Improving game pacing[/b] by adding tension with a boss and mini-boss
[*] [b]Completing bug fixing[/b]
[*] [b]Nightmare phobias[/b]: encountering a phobia the 2nd time makes it more powerful
[*] [b]Nursery Room[/b]: you start a run with new traits that will alter your session right from the start
[*] [b]Unlocking rework[/b]: you can unlock wayyy more content overall but by reusing the content already produced (cards, mental trials, etc.)
[*] [b]Improving Survey room[/b]
[/list]

[h3]Second priority: (hopes for the 2nd month)[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Adding new mini-stories[/b] here and there [b]to improve the link to the mental health theme[/b]
[*] [b]3 new rooms [/b]that will improve replayability
[*] [b]Improving card design[/b] and [b]making new unique effects[/b]
[*] [b]Improving UI / UX[/b] in several ways (more reactive, more ergonomic)
[*] [b]Adding new resilience levels[/b]
[*] [b]Adding new mental trials[/b]
[*] [b]Remaking the tutorial[/b]
[/list]

[h3]Third priority: (hopes for the 3rd month)[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]3 new phobias[/b]
[*] [b]15 new cards[/b] (not sure how they’ll be attributed yet)
[*] [b]Improving FX & game feel during fights[/b]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36907763/0666332925f93d9f39bec4a2d0227876a19b7b33.gif[/img]

[h3]Thank you to all the persons who support the game and who are helping in its improvement everyday![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1253860/Neurodeck__Psychological_Deckbuilder/

notes.title: Neurodeck is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We are so excited to announce that [h2]NEURODECK IS OUT NOW![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36907763/a856e0e98c3719fb4ccc90e9e20765c5e115a0e3.gif[/img]

[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Deckbuilding[/b] as you progress through the game (Slay The Spire like)
[*] [b]Meditate and choose personality traits[/b] that alter your gameplay profoundly
[*] [b]Explore a subconscious maze[/b], full of cards and improvements that will help you defeat the monsters in your mind
[*][b] Light RPG mechanics[/b] that allow you to customize your character stats & skills
[*] [b]Characters & places from your past[/b] that will tell facts & stories about mental health
[*] [b]Deep gameplay mechanics[/b] that put focus on replayability and gameplay diversity
[*] [b]Horrific monsters[/b] inspired by real-life phobias

notes.title: Patchnote 0.4.7 and news
notes.content:
Hello there!

We're close to the release and should have fixed all critical bugs. We still have a good list of things remaining, but the game looks stable. If it's not, don't hesitate to tell us!

Demo & Beta have been updated. The demo is still limited to one emotion, while the beta is open to the whole content.

Localization is still very WIP!

[h1]Patchnote[/h1]
--------------

[b]Gameplay[/b]

This update introduces the “Resilience” system, which constitutes an additional level of challenge for the runs. It works like the “ascension” system of other roguelike/deckbuilders such as Slay the Spire, and will give experienced players new difficulty levels to try out. In relation to these new difficulty levels, some cards in the game have slightly been buffed and/or reworked. This will help Neurodeck deliver a game experience with a better learning curve.
A new “Living Room” room has been added to the game, and will allow players to unlock new cards to play in subsequent runs. In consequence, some cards have been removed from the base pool for all emotions.


[b]Gameplay changes[/b]

[list]
[*] Writing Therapy (Jupiter card) has been reworked.
[*] Play Jigsaw (Jupiter card) has been reworked.
[*] The effect of the “Extraverted” trait has changed.
[/list]

[b]Balancing[/b]

[list]
[*] Nyctophobia has been nerfed in several ways. Its power level should be closer from the power level of other phobias of this rank.
[*] -> Phobia Sanity has been reduced.
[*] -> Heat Flash (Nyctophobia) has been nerfed to an heal of 15 sanity.
[*] Slight nerf on some of Blennophobia’s attacks.
[*] Buffed the “Generous” trait.
[/list]

[b]Balancing - Cards[/b]

[list]
[*] Slight buff on Comfort Food (all characters) : Sanity gain is now 5 points (instead of 4).
[*] Slight buff on Flip a Coin (Lei - Joy)
[*] Night Walk, Christmas Day and Old Uncle (Lei - Surprise) have been buffed.
[*] Circle of Sadness, Hammock, Violin, Loneliness, Dog Petting (Jupiter - Sadness) has been buffed.
[*] Family Photo, Deck of Cards, Camping Tent, Hot Bath, Baking Cake, Writing Therapy. (Jupiter - All) have been buffed.
[*] Some phobia cards have been buffed.
[/list]

[b]Visual[/b]

[list]
[*] Added animations for Nosophobia, Theophobia.
[*] Added card illustrations for the “phobia cards”.
[*] Phobia room illustrations have been updated.
[/list]

[b]UX[/b]

[list]
[*] The Collection interface (main menu) has been improved ! It should be more aesthetic.
[*] The Collection interface now also previews the phobias encountered in a run.
[/list]

[b]Team[/b]

Victoria and Killian have finished working on the game. Thank you very much for the work done on Neurodeck ! They worked a lot on the art direction and programming respectively, so kudos for this amazing work.
Teddy has joined the team ! He will help us work on additional development and bug fixing for the game for a few month.

[b]Audio[/b]

Added additional sound effects to the game. Audio work on Neurodeck is approaching completion : new sounds and/or reworks for Tokophobia, Squalophobia, Herpetophobia, Phasmophobia, Nosophobia, Blennophobia, Haptophobia, Agoraphobia, Theophobia UI and special effects such as card lock have been added.

[b]Bug fixing [/b]

[list]
[*] Bugs tied to the Living Room (room that unlocks cards) have been fixed.
[*] Fixed bugs tied to sounds and game music.
[*] Fixed a bug tied to the damage counter of Helio/Nyctophobia.
[*] Fixed a bug tied to controllers.
[*] Fixed some bugs tied to phobia animations.
[*] Fixed a problem on one of Nosophobia’s attacks.
[*] Fixed a bug occuring at flor 29 (you could choose between two phobias).
[*] Fixed a bug tied to Anxiety effects.
[*] Fixed a bug tied to Kitchen effects.
[*] Fixed a problem tied to the interaction of “Board Game Party” with Wrath effects.
[*] Fixed a problem tied to the interaction between Spicy Food and Wrath effects.
[*] Fixed a problem with “Introverted” when Jupiter was selected.
[*] Fixed a bug tied to Item damage.
[*] Fixed a bug tied to Egg Hunt
[*] Fixed a bug occuring on Title Screen.
[*] Fixed a bug occuring on the Library room
[*] Fixed a bug on the Dependant/Independant survey
[*] Fixed a sprite bug on Nyctophobia
[*] Fixed a transition bug on Nyctophobia/Heliophobia
[*] Fixed a bug on trials (hands were random)
[*] Fixed a bug tied to the “Hug” card (Lei - Joy)
[*] Fixed a freeze bug occuring when the game was closed.
[*] Fixed a bug tied to traits.
[*] Fixed a bug on the “Frown” card.
[*] Fixed bugs tied to the “invincible” phase of Nyctophobia.
[/list]

Other

We worked on optimisation, in order to help Neurodeck run on computer with smaller specs.


What is planned for the upcoming weeks ? 

We are entering the last phase before the release of the game. We wil; focus on bug fixing and polishing the game experience, in order to deliver the best experience possible.
We are also working on translations for Neurodeck, in order to allow players from different countries to enjoy the game.

notes.title: Big Patch 0.3.8
notes.content:
This beginning of November brings us closer to release!

There are a lot of new stuff, but we'll not start to differentiate the beta and public demo branch.

Private Beta : ask for access on Discord. Features the whole content.
Public Demo : play easily on Steam, but you can only play the first character and the first emotion.

[b]What changed :[/b]

[b]Gameplay[/b]

[list]
[*] This update introduces Neurodeck’s new character, “Jupiter”. She comes with a new “Inner Peace” mechanic that takes the place of Lei’s “Mind Focus”, a new “Meditate” keyword, and 34 new cards. As of now the character has only its first “Sadness” emotion available.
[*] Added a new phobia! Or two actually? Nyctophobia represents the fear of the dark, and Heliophobia represents the fear of intense light. The phobia alternates between these two phases in battle, and you will need to think strategically to defeat this powerful opponent!
[*] Added another new phobia : Nosophobia, the fear of diseases. This one constitutes another boss you can  encounter at the end of the Neurodeck maze, as well as Phasmo for example. We hope it will give players an interesting battle!
[*] You cannot encounter two phobias of the same kind (two “Arachno” for exemple) anymore. This is part of a small rework we are currently doing on encounters, more about that soon!
[/list]



[b]Balancing[/b]

As we are introducing a lot of content on this update, balancing might change a bit in the following weeks. Feedback on this point really helps us to understand what works best and what should be reworked, so feel free to share your thoughts with us!

[b]Visual[/b]

[list]
[*] 15 new card illustrations have been added to the game.
[*] Nycto/Heliophobia and Nosophobia come with new animations!
[*] Reworked the card template. This one should be more aesthetically pleasing and allows for a better display of important informations.
[/list]

UX

[list]
[*] The new card template now indicates the pool a card comes from : for example, if it’s tied to an emotion or common to all emotions of a specific character.
[*] Fixed a display problem on the text on Squalophobia’s second attack.
[/list]

[b]Team[/b]

Whaïd joined the team ! He is doing a work-and-study program in video game development and will help in the development of Neurodeck. 

[b]Bug fixing [/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed bugs occuring when Jupiter card effects were played.
[*] Fixed bugs tied to the Meditation Jauge of Jupiter. 
[*] Fixed bugs tied to the new “Inner Peace” effect.
[*] Fixed problem tied to music and sound effects, that could stop playing on specific circumstances.
[*] Fixed a bug where the wrong name could display on cards (“Lei” instead of “Jupiter” for exemple).
[*] Fixed a problem on tutorial that prevented it to display in game.
[/list]

[b]What is planned for the upcoming weeks? [/b]

[list]
[*] The second emotion of Jupiter” is currently in a pre-production phase. We are working on it, and it should release around january.
[*] We are currently reworking the encounters in nerodeck in order to make the difficulty curve more interesting. There’s already a modification in this update, and it will be continued in the next. 
[*] New art will replace the placeholder illustrations on some of Jupiter’s cards.
[/list]

notes.title: September update - 0.2.8
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36907763/6a203d3815103359cee30e8dc230e68761d56a7c.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!
A lot of changes going into the alpha version! It will only be an alpha (access through our Discord!). It is very hard to process through all the changes that went into this update, sorry if it's not complete!

What changed :

[b]Gameplay[/b]

[list]
[*] This update introduces the Neurodeck’s “unlock system”. Some cards are now locked at the beginning of a run, and the player can unlock them through the new “Memory Revival” room.
[*] Added a new kind of cards that can give players passive effects on several turns. These effects are a bit stronger than modifiers, and will allow players to try new strategies.
[*] Added a new “Memorial” room. It allows you to remove a card from your deck during a run.
[*] *Added a new “Kitchen” room. It allows you to get powerful temporary buffs, in anticipation of a specific fight.*
[*] The maze is now composed of 30 floors (instead of 20).
[*] This update adds a new emotion for Lei : the “Surprise” emotion. “Surprise” comes with a new basic card and 15 new cards you can find during runs including unique effects, passives and equipments. We hope you’ll like it!
[*] Added 7 other new cards : “Flip a Coin”, “Stroll”, “Sunbath”, “Recycling” and “House Party” for the “Anger” emotion of Lei, “Caring Thought” and “Meditation Session” for all emotions of Lei.
[*] Added “Sharkophobia” (rank 2) to the game. It can devour your cards!
[*] Added “Haptophobia” (rank 1) to the game. It can “lock” your cards in place, making them impossible to play.
[*] Phobia must now be fought once to be present in the “phobiadex”.
[*] Controller support is currently in QA but you can try it :) Should work with keyboard as well.
[/list]

[b]Balancing[/b]

[list]
[*] “Shower” is now belongs to rank 2 (previously : rank 3). Its STA cost increased a bit (from 0 to 15).
[*] “Self-Blaming” now belongs at rank 3 (previously : rank 2).
[*] “Angry Scribbling” was nerfed a little bit and now fades after use.
[*] “Phasmophobia” has now 120 Sanity points (+ 20)
[/list]

[b]Visual[/b]

[list]
[*] Added a new illustration for the Can Kicking and Self-Blaming cards.
[*] Added animations for Tokophobia, Sharkophobia, Agoraphobia, Phasmophobia and Squalophobia.
[*] Events now have specific icons in exploration mode.
[*] Added a new “Forest” background, the old one is now called “Shrooms”.
[*] Added illustrations for 9 of the new cards present in the Surprise emotion.
[/list]

[b]Sound[/b]

[list]
[*] Added SFX for Entomophobia, masculinity, and much more...
[/list]

[b]UX[/b]

[list]
[*] The fight interface now shows the number of Faded/Discarded cards this fight.
[/list]

[b]Team[/b]

Sophie Maleval joined the team as a 2D artist. She has been making new illustrations for Neurodeck (some of which were previewed on Twitter in the last weeks). She’s already finished but helped making around 20+ illustrations as a helping hand!


Bug fixing 

[list]
[*] Fixed the Introverted/Extraverted survey (it could give players the wrong trait).
[*] Fixed animations that could blur on Myso and Arachno.
[*] Fixed bugs tied to new cards and effects.
[*] Fixed a visual bug on monster Sanity.
[*] Fixed a bug on the amount of Sanity of the “Eel Punching” trial.
[*] Fixed a sound bug that could crash the game.
[*] .... and many more!
[/list]

[b]Other[/b]

[list]
[*] Agora’s attack names have changed in this version
[*] The card “French Insult” is now called “Altercation” (the effect is the same)
[/list]




What is planned for the upcoming weeks ? 

The second character of Neurodeck, “Jupiter”, is currently in a pre-production phase. We should release its first emotion in the coming month, with a new mechanic tied to the character.
We are working on controller support! It should be added to the game later this year.
New phobias will be added to the game in a future update. They will diversify our current pool, and offer a new variety of challenges to players. This update already adds 2 phobias for the lower ranks (1 & 2). We are aiming for

[b]What changed : [/b]

[b][h3]Gameplay[/h3][/b]
[b]Added a new “Meditation” room[/b] that allows you to unlock the traits/phobias/deck informations.
[b]Card pools are now differentiated between each emotion.[/b] Some cards are “neutral” (common to all emotions), and other are tied to one specific emotion
New “Collection” tab on the menu, where you can see all cards in the game. It’s still WIP, but it will give you an overview of the feature
A new “Mental Trials” tab has appeared on the main menu. It’s not active currently, but you will learn more about it soon
You can now equip traits directly after a survey

[b][h3]Cards[/h3][/b]
[b]Added new content for the “Joy” emotion of Lei. 13 new cards [/b]with a lot of unique effects have been added to the game! It should allow you to try a lot of different strategies
Two new base cards have been added to the “Joy” emotion of Lei
[b]The “Resentment”, “Inner Strength” and “Friends” cards now belong to the “Joy” card pool [/b](you can’t find them anymore with “Anger”)
Neutral pool : [b]added the “Psychology Book” equipment[/b] to the game
Neutral pool : [b]removed “Lullaby”  from the game[/b]. It might come back someday with another design, but we felt it was not an interesting option for players to pick
Neutral pool : [b]removed “Growth” [/b]for the same reason
Neutral pool : [b]removed “Anarchy”[/b], that will be reworked
Anger pool : [b]removed “Letting go”[/b] (might be replaced by something else in the future)
Anger pool : [b]reworked “Big Cleaning” [/b](new effect)
[b]Reworked Retrogaming, Alcohol [/b](neutral pool) [b]and Inner Strength [/b](Joy pool) to make them more simple

[b][h3]Balancing[/h3][/b]
[b]Nerfed Blennophobia.[/b] You can now fight it without risking nightmares
Nerfed Warm Tea, that now draws only two cards (down from three)
Nerfed the “Resourceful” trait, that now draws only two cards at the beginning of a fight (down from three)
Small nerf on the “Adventurous” trait (now gives 4 HP per trigger instead of 5)

[b][h3]Visual[/h3][/b]
[b]Added new illustrations for “Anger” : Comfy Bed, Kombucha, Flow, Spooning[/b]
[b]Added new illustrations for neutral cards : Broom, Pain Pill[/b]
Changed the “Self-Harm” card name to “Tattoos”. Added the correspondent illustration to the game.
Changed the “Therapy Session” card name to “Stressball”. Added the correspondent illustration to the game
[b]Added animations to the game : Arachnophobia, Herpetophobia, ToxicMascu and Entomophobia are now animated.[/b]
In game, HP and SAN heal is now animated

[b][h3]Audio[/h3][/b]
[b]Added menu, fight and exploration musics.[/b]
Added sound effects to Arachnophobia
Added sound effects to Blennophobia
[b]Added sound effects to fights[/b]: start of a turn, phobia attacks, playing cards and more
Added sound effects to the Gymnasium room
Added UI sounds

[b][h3]UX[/h3][/b]
[b]Discarded cards are now shown to the player.[/b]
Added screenshake on some elements
Added a visual effect that triggers when the player heals

[b][h3]Bug fixing[/h3][/b]
Fixed a bug occuring when a card was supposed to be played on discard
[b]Fixed a bug on the display of the tutorial.[/b]
Fixed a bug occuring on equipments that gave actions to the player (ex: Friends)
Fixed a bug that affected Gymnasium options
Fixed some bugs occuring when the new effects were triggered.
Fixed bugs tied to the new features
Fixed a problem on the “Deep Breath” card (created by some cards of “Joy”)
Fixed a problem with the “Nails Chew” card
Fixed sprite and animation bugs

[b][h3]Team [/h3][/b]
[b]Tilianna and Nicolas[/b] joined the team! They are working on [b]music and sound effects [/b]to give Neurodeck a distinct atmosphere. You can hear some of their works in the new version of the game!

[b][h3]What is planned for the upcoming weeks ? [/h3][/b]
We will progressively add new illustrations for the “Joy” emotion of Lei. It will replace the beta art currently present in the cards.
New phobias are coming! They will diversify the current pool and challenge players in different ways.
As we introduced a lot of cards at once, expect some balancing in the next weeks. Player feedback is very useful on this point, so feel free to tell us about your experience! 
New cards will be added to the “Anger” and “Neutral” pools.
New sound effects and musics will be integrated to the game, and will contribute to shape an unique atmosphere for Neurodeck.
New “stories” will be added to rooms and will help us integrate more narrative elements to the game.
The new “Mental Trials” game mode will be added to the game at some point. More about this later!

notes.title: Update V.0.2.4
notes.content:
Update V.0.2.4 is here! It adds a new room preview feature for the exploration phase, balancing on cards and phobias and UX improvements. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/4QzfNij.jpg[/img]


[b]What changed : [/b]

[b][h3]Gameplay[/h3][/b]

Nerfed “Comfy Bed”. The card is now at Tier 2 and has only 1 durability.
Nerfed the “Lazy” trait. It now gives less stacks of modifiers.
Reduced the cost of “Moving”, “Writing about day”, “Big Cleaning”, “Kombucha” and “Anarchy”
Buffed “Kombucha” : it now heals 15 HP for each equipment.
Buffed the phobias “Herpetophobia” and “ToxicMascu” 
[b]Buffed the phobia boss “Phasmo”[/b]

[b][h3]Visual[/h3][/b]

Fixed some problems on the animations of “Blennophobia”
[b]The exploration has a new preview system (top of the screen)[/b]

The new preview system now indicates the rooms where the player will face phobias

[b][h3]UX[/h3][/b]

Improved visual effects on the main menu
Added modifier tooltips on phobia attacks
Harmonized the display of modifiers
Active equipements give you a preview of their card on hover.

[b][h3]Bug fixing[/h3][/b]

Fixed a bug that blocked the “Main Menu” button on the defeat screen.
Fixed a problem with the display of modifiers on cards on the player’s hand.
Fixed a bug on “ToxicMascu” attacks.
Fixed a bug on the survey “Lazy vs. Neat Freak”
Fixed a bug on the description of the “Anxiety” modifier
Classroom will now convert correctly the cards
Fixed a bug with the “Permadeck” interface
[b]Fixed a bug on the “gain actions” effect. It now gives the correct amount of actions to the player.[/b]

[b][h3]What is planned for the upcoming weeks ? [/h3][/b]

We will focus on reshaping the second emotion of Jupiter (“Joy”). It will include new exclusive cards for this emotion, that will allow you to find new strategies to defeat phobias.
You will progressively see new animations be integrated in the game. Fights will be more dynamic and have different atmospheres depending on the specific phobias.

You can download the new build now in the beta branch on Steam. We would love to hear your feedback!

notes.title: Neurodeck : Update V.0.2.2
notes.content:
Hi folks, Update V.0.2.2 is now live ! 

You can get a key by joining the newsletter or Discord.
Check out : https://neurodeck-game.com/ for more details.

What changed : 

[h3][b]Gameplay[/b][/h3]

- Global balancing on phobias, with the intent of raising the difficulty by a little bit and to further differentiate the fights.
- Balancing on cards : we nerfed some that we felt were too powerful at this time, and buffed other cards that seemed underpowered. Special thanks to the players that answered our small survey on Discord!
- Added 4 cards : Resentment, Inner Strength, Kombucha and Grandpa’s Medal.
- Moved “Entomophobia” up in ranking : you will encounter this powerful foe later in your run.
- You can now equip passive abilities on the trait pannel in the exploration menu (it has a small book icon). “Meditation” rooms do not appear anymore in runs.

[h3][b]Team [/b][/h3]

- Jeanne has joined the team as a 2D animator! She will work in collaboration with Victoria in order to give life to the phobias that dwell in your mind and on the Neurodeck system. 

[h3][b]Bugs [/b][/h3]

- Fixed a few bugs tied to the application of buffs/debuffs on enemies.


[b]What is planned for the upcoming weeks ? [/b]

- We will focus on reshaping the second emotion of Jupiter (“Joy”). It will include new exclusive cards for this emotion, that will allow you to find new strategies to defeat phobias.
- Game difficulty is one of the subjects we are working on currently. We’re trying to find the right balance between “too easy” and “too hard” for the game, so there might be some changes in the next updates. Feedback are super useful on this, so feel free to tell us what you think of its current state!
- You will progressively see new animations be integrated in the game. Fights will be more dynamic and have different atmospheres depending on the specific phobias.
- New art for the cards is coming up ! Stay tuned :)

You can download the new build now in the beta branch on Steam. We would love to hear your feedback!

notes.title: Neurodeck v0.2.0
notes.content:
[h2]v0.2.0[/h2]

You can get a key by joining the newsletter or Discord.
Check out : [url=https://neurodeck-game.com/]https://neurodeck-game.com/[/url] for more details.

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added 2 new phobias with a new distinctive artwork : “Toxic Masculinity“ and “Mysophobia“. These should show up a bit before the end boss and offer a different kind of challenge.
[*] We made a global rework for all phobias included in the game (new attacks, new stats, new patterns).
[*] We also began a global rework of cards, traits and emotions in the game. This patch includes 10+ new cards for Jupiter’s “Anger” emotion and new effects that will allow you to try different strategies.
[*] Balancing on a few gameplay elements. It’s part of a global process we will continue working on in the next weeks.
[*] Panelodex => Cardodex + Traitodex + Phobiadex are now in game. Customize your deck & traits, inspect monsters. More gameplay freedom for a complete experience.
[/list]

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[list]
[*] A new WIP background for game fights
[*] A complete rework of the Exploration UI, still in integration phase
[*] New character art for Lei, Jupiter is coming (we swapped them in the meantime)
[/list]

[h2]UI/UX[/h2]

[list]
[*]Global improvement of the quality of fights : these changes should improve the game feel and give players a better gameplay experience while fighting phobias.
[*]UI change for the exploration phase!
[/list]

[h2]Bugs [/h2]

Fixed a few problems that could occur during runs.

[h2]What is planned for the upcoming weeks ? [/h2]

[list]
[*]The rework of cards and balancing of elements (cards, monsters…) will continue in the next weeks. As of now a few things have been conceptualized, but it is important for us to integrate players feedback in our design process.
[*]A major change in gameplay is also coming in the next weeks, and should modify a few things in the way you build and balance your decks. You will be able to try new strategies more efficiently in a run, and approach card drops from a different perspective.
[*]We are also working on new rooms and another feature, that we will tell you about soon :)
[/list]

You can download the new build now in the beta branch on Steam. We would love to hear your feedback!

Patchnote written by Rak, our new Game design Intern.
Cheers from Victoria (Graphic artist), Kilian (game developer), Léonard (narrative designer), Roman (Sound design) and Creative director (Tavrox).

Stay safe.
